svg.desc: Greater Cairo Metro Line 1 Projects LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT National Authority for Tunnels (NAT) COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2021 80 million Euros DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Architectural Design Electrical Engineering Structural / Civil Engineering Project Overview Supervision of Kozzika Metro Workshop This project for the National Authority for Tunnels (NAT) involved the supervision of the Kozzika Metro Workshop, with an estimated construction value of 80 million Euros. Services included architecture, structural and civil works, MEP, project management, and full site supervision. Construction & Commissioning of 20 Trains Completed in 2021 for NAT, this 120 million Euro project covered the construction and commissioning of 20 metro trains.
